title: Nasdaq Announces Retirement of Two Depth Solution Products
summary: Nasdaq retires Nasdaq Level 2 and TotalView Aggregated as part of the 23/5 expansion. Customers must migrate to TotalView 5.0 or TotalView Plus 1.0 before the retirement date; parallel period until then, no additional licensing cost.
quote: Following this date, access to both products will be discontinued for all customers.
